```{r}
library(ape)
library(treeio)
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)

beast_tree_run3 <- read.beast("~/Downloads/Boxfish/beast/run3_beast_MCC_CA.tre")
beast_tree_run3@phylo <- root(beast_tree_run3@phylo, "Triodon_macropterus", resolve.root = TRUE)
beast_tree_run3@phylo$tip.label <- gsub("_", " ", beast_tree_run3@phylo$tip.label)

root_age <- max(node.depth.edgelength(as.phylo(beast_tree_run3)))
cat("Root age:", root_age, "Ma\n")

ggtree(beast_tree_run3, right = TRUE) +
  geom_tiplab(fontface = "italic", size = 3) +
  geom_nodelab(aes(label = round(posterior, 2)),
               size = 2, hjust = 1.5, vjust = -0.6) +
  theme_tree2() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, root_age, by = 10),
    labels = function(x) round(root_age - x, 0),
    name   = "Million years ago (Ma)",
    limits = c(0, root_age + 35)
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = root_age - c(23, 34, 56),
             linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
  annotate("text", x = root_age - c(23, 34, 56), y = 3,
           label = c("Miocene", "Oligocene", "Eocene"),
           size = 2.5, angle = 90, vjust = -0.3, colour = "grey40") +
  labs(title = "BEAST total evidence timetree (30 taxa, ~60M generations)")
 # geom_range(range = "height_0.95_HPD", color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.3, size = 2)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
# Check root node annotations
beast_tree_run3@data |> 
  filter(node == length(beast_tree_run3@phylo$tip.label) + 1) |>
  select(height, height_0.95_HPD)

beast_tree_run3@data |> 
  filter(node == length(beast_tree_run3@phylo$tip.label) + 1) |>
  pull(height_0.95_HPD)

root_age
# Find root node number
root_node <- length(beast_tree_run3@phylo$tip.label) + 1

# Check its height and HPD
beast_tree_run3@data |>
  filter(node == root_node) |>
  select(node, height, height_0.95_HPD, posterior)
```

```{r}
library(ape)
phyl <- as.phylo(beast_tree_run3)
cat("Root node number:", phyl$Nnode + length(phyl$tip.label) - (phyl$Nnode - 1), "\n")
cat("Root node:", Ntip(phyl) + 1, "\n")
beast_tree_run3@data |>
  arrange(desc(height)) |>
  select(node, height, posterior) |>
  head(20)
```

```{r}
prior_tree <- read.beast("~/Downloads/Boxfish/beast/prior_MCC.tre")
prior_tree@phylo <- root(prior_tree@phylo, "Triodon_macropterus", resolve.root = TRUE)
prior_tree@phylo$tip.label <- gsub("_", " ", prior_tree@phylo$tip.label)

root_age_prior <- max(node.depth.edgelength(as.phylo(prior_tree)))
cat("Prior-only root age:", root_age_prior, "Ma\n")

ggtree(prior_tree, right = TRUE) +
  geom_tiplab(fontface = "italic", size = 3) +
  geom_range(range = "height_0.95_HPD", color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.3, size = 2) +
  theme_tree2() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, root_age_prior, by = 10),
    labels = function(x) round(root_age_prior - x, 0),
    name   = "Million years ago (Ma)",
    limits = c(0, root_age_prior + 35)
  ) +
```
